# GitHub Copilot Instructions

All project rules live in [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md). Read it before taking any action.

This file exists as a GitHub Copilot / VS Code discovery shim per **P0-11 Portable Agent Surface**.

## Copilot-Specific Notes

- GitHub Copilot automatically loads `.github/copilot-instructions.md` at session start. No additional configuration needed.
- Do not add project-wide rules to this file. Add them to `AGENTS.md` instead.
- When `AGENTS.md` changes, this shim does not need updating unless Copilot-specific overrides are required.
